issues.failure_explanation: The step in (momhat) needs the identity <mathcal I^{-1}e_j, mathcal I^{-1}e_j>_{L^2} = <mathcal I^{-2}e_j, e_j> with mathcal I^{-2} then bounded on H^{eta_0} via Condition F, i.e. it needs the inverse of mathcal I = Delta * I*I (I the derivative map) to be self-adjoint. Delta and I*I are each self-adjoint but do not commute, so mathcal I is not self-adjoint in general, and no hypothesis or lemma in the source establishes such symmetry. Without it, Cauchy-Schwarz plus Condition F only gives <mathcal I^{-1}e_j, mathcal I^{-1}e_j> = O(lambda_j^{eta_0}), so the sum is bounded by sum_j lambda_j^{-k+eta_0}, finite only under the extra restriction k > eta_0 + d/2, which is not among the hypotheses. The bound is in fact true (via bar e_j = (I*I)^{-1}e_j and self-adjointness of (I*I)^{-1}, whose inverse mapping properties follow from Condition F), but that derivation is absent from the source.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Redo (momhat) using bar e_j = (I_{theta_0}^* I_{theta_0})^{-1} e_j: since I*I and its inverse are self-adjoint and, by Condition F, I*I maps H^eta_0 to H^{eta+2}_0 with bounded inverse, one gets <bar e_j, bar e_j>_{L^2} = O(lambda_j^2), hence sum_j lambda_j^{-k-2}||bar e_j||^2 <= C sum_j lambda_j^{-k} < infinity; the same repair covers the invocations in (uiui) and in the mean-asymptotics.
issues.overall_effect: The bound N E||hat theta_N - theta_0||^2_{H^{-k-2}} <= C and the H^{-k-2}-well-definedness of the centring hat theta_N are unproven; term b) in the proof of Proposition prop:added-1 (via (uiui)) and the posterior-mean asymptotics concluding the proof of Theorem mainbvm are unestablished, so Theorems mainbvm, bvminv and ganzwien are not proved by the given argument.
issues.title: Moment bound for the centring rests on unstated self-adjointness of the information operator
issues.why_classification: A single operator-theoretic inference is unjustified; a contained re-derivation using objects and mapping properties already in the source establishes the identical bound under the stated hypotheses, so no claim, rate or scope is lost, but the fix is a non-routine local re-derivation rather than a routine patch.

issues.failure_explanation: E_J is spanned by the first J+1 Laplace eigenfunctions and (weyl) gives lambda_j ~ j^{2/d}, so the correct bounds are ||P_{E_J}phi - phi||_{L^2} <= C lambda_J^{-gamma/2}||phi||_{H^gamma} ~ J^{-gamma/d}||phi||_{H^gamma} and ||P_{E_J}phi||_{H^gamma} <= C max(1, J^{(gamma-r)/d})||phi||_{H^r}; the displayed exponents (without the factor 1/d) hold only for d=1 and are false for d>=2 (test phi = a single eigenmode just above J). The second bound is valid but loose, and K_{N,bar kappa} in (approxrkhs) inherits the loose exponent. Consequently the identity after (postbus00), delta_N^2 sqrt(N) J_N^{gamma-bar kappa} = N^{-(bar kappa-d/2)/(2gamma+d)}, is false for d>=2: with J_N ~ N delta_N^2 the left side equals N^{((d-1)gamma - d*bar kappa + d/2)/(2gamma+d)}, which diverges whenever bar kappa < ((d-1)gamma+d/2)/d, values compatible with all hypotheses of Theorem mainbvm (e.g. d=2, gamma>=10, k near its lower bound), so the Cameron-Martin log-density bound is unproven and can fail. Likewise the convergences claimed in (quadbd) and in the sqrt(N)(tilde delta_N(0) J_N^{-kappa} + J_N^{-2kappa}) = o(1) step of the proof of Theorem laplaceapp do not follow from the stated bounds (and fail for admissible parameters, e.g. gamma large). The derivation of (postbus0) also shifts the integration region without tracking the change-of-variables factor. All multidimensional applications (d=2,3) are affected.

All theorem statements then hold under the stated hypotheses.
issues.overall_effect: The Cameron-Martin density-ratio bound and the replacement of p_N(bar psi) by bar psi - central steps in the proof of Theorem laplaceapp and in the ratio bounds (postbus0)-(postlim) used for Proposition prop:added-1 - are unproven as written for d>=2; hence the proofs of Theorems laplaceapp, mainbvm, bvminv and ganzwien are invalid for d>=2.

issues.why_classification: The repair is a contained but multi-step correction of exponent scalings plus one sharper available estimate; no theorem, rate or advertised regime is lost, but several central displayed derivations must be redone.

issues.failure_explanation: Because vartheta = sqrt(N)(theta-T) and vartheta_0 = sqrt(N)(theta_0-T), the tail region {||vartheta - vartheta_0||_{H^{-k-2}} > 1} in the Villani splitting equals {||theta - theta_0||_{H^{-k-2}} > 1/sqrt(N)}, not {||theta - theta_0||_{H^{-k-2}} > 1}. The proof bounds the second term over the wrong, much smaller set, and it claims the third term vanishes because ||theta - theta_0||_{H^{-k-2}} <= L tilde delta_N(0) < 1 on Theta-bar_N; but only ||theta - theta_0||_{L^2} <= L tilde delta_N(0) is available there and sqrt(N) tilde delta_N(0) -> infinity, so sqrt(N)||theta - theta_0||_{H^{-k-2}} can exceed 1 throughout Theta-bar_N and neither tail integral is shown to vanish. The proposition's conclusion is nevertheless true and follows from (tvbd) and Theorem postcont by a corrected transportation estimate.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: From Markov's inequality and Lemma \ref{oldtimer} below we deduce that the remainder terms $R_{t,N},W_{t,N}$ are all $o_{P_{\theta_0}^\mathbb N}(1)$ uniformly in $\theta \in \bar \Theta_N$ and $\psi \in U(\kappa+2,B)$.

issues.failure_explanation: The weak variance of f_{theta,psi} equals ||g_{theta,psi}||^2_{L^2(X)}, where g is the linearisation residual G(theta_{(t,psi)}) - G(theta_0) - DG[theta_{(t,psi)}-theta_0]. The displayed bound invokes the Lipschitz Condition B, giving sigma_N ~ tilde delta_N(zeta). But the subsequent order calculation (the first chaining term being of order sqrt(N) tilde delta_N^{2-d/beta}(zeta), via sqrt(N) int_0^{sigma_N} u^{-d/2beta} du) is consistent only with sigma_N ~ tilde delta_N(zeta)^2, which follows from the quadratic Condition C bound ||g|| <= c||h||^2_{L^2}, not from B. With the stated sigma_N the first term is of order sqrt(N) tilde delta_N^{1-d/2beta}(zeta); since beta > 2d gives 1 - d/2beta > 3/4 while tilde delta_N(zeta) = N^{-gamma(bar gamma - zeta)/((2gamma+d)(bar gamma+1))} with that exponent < 1/2, this diverges (at least like N^{1/8}), so the lemma's conclusion does not follow from the proof as written.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Bound the weak variances by the Condition C estimate: on Theta-bar_N one has ||theta - theta_0||_{L^2} <= L tilde delta_N(0) <= c' and h = theta - theta_0 - (t/sqrt(N)) p_N(bar psi) stays in a fixed H^{bar gamma}-ball (using (1/sqrt(N))||p_N(bar psi)||_{H^{bar gamma}} -> 0), so Ef_{theta,psi}^2 <= C(tilde delta_N(zeta)^4 + N^{-2}) =: sigma_N^2; the displayed orders and the lemma then follow.
issues.overall_effect: The control of the stochastic remainder terms R_{t,N}, W_{t,N} - and hence the proof of Theorem laplaceapp and, through it, of Proposition prop:added-1 and Theorems mainbvm, bvminv and ganzwien - is unproven as written.
issues.title: Weak-variance bound in the empirical-process lemma is inconsistent with its own chaining calculation
issues.why_classification: The proof's central variance input must be replaced by a different available hypothesis with a short uniformity verification; the lemma and all downstream claims survive, but the stated estimate cannot be repaired by changing constants.
